findings.claim: The tech lead agent is granted non-read-only tools despite the acceptance criterion requiring Agent plus read-only tools.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 requires `.claude/agents/fhir-tech-lead.md` to use "Agent + read-only tools"; the frontmatter lists `tools: Agent, Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, SendMessage`, and `Bash` can mutate the repository or environment.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `Bash` from the tech lead tool list, or narrow the criterion if mutation-capable tools are intentionally allowed.

findings.claim: The ideation strategist lists a required skill that is not vendored or otherwise shown to resolve locally.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.2 says to "verify frontmatter parses and skills resolve"; the frontmatter lists `idea-refine`, but the diff only vendors `.claude/skills/karpathy-guidelines/` and adds no `.claude/skills/idea-refine/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Vendor the `idea-refine` skill locally, remove it from frontmatter, or add the prerequisite/resolution mechanism required by the agent loader.

findings.claim: The tech lead lists a required skill that is not vendored or otherwise shown to resolve locally or documented as a prerequisite.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 requires "every listed skill resolves locally or is noted as a prerequisite"; the frontmatter lists `kbd-process-orchestrator`, but the diff only adds `.claude/skills/karpathy-guidelines/` and no prerequisite document for `kbd-process-orchestrator`.
findings.suggested_fix: Vendor `kbd-process-orchestrator` locally, remove it from frontmatter, or add an explicit prerequisite note in the agent documentation.

findings.claim: The architect lists a required skill that is not vendored or otherwise shown to resolve locally.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.3 says to "verify frontmatter parses and skills resolve"; the frontmatter lists `kbd-plan`, but the diff only adds `.claude/skills/karpathy-guidelines/` and no `.claude/skills/kbd-plan/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Vendor the `kbd-plan` skill locally, remove it from frontmatter, or add the prerequisite/resolution mechanism required by the agent loader.
